title: Reducing inequality
log: 2026-11-01T08:04:32Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new

match.reason: The bank point covers the costs and benefits of inequality, while the new point is about government policies that reduce it, so it teaches a different idea.

draft.title: Reducing inequality
card: Higher income earners pay a larger share of their income in tax. The money raised can fund support for others.
Payments such as the age pension or JobSeeker give income to people who cannot earn enough. They lift the incomes of lower income households.
A legal minimum wage sets the lowest hourly pay an employer can offer. This raises the pay of the lowest paid workers.
Government funded education and health care help people build skills and stay well. Access does not depend on how much a person earns.
draft.remember: Taxing more from high incomes and supporting lower incomes both reduce inequality.

a.q: Which feature makes an income tax system progressive?
opts: Higher earners pay a larger share of income in tax
Everyone pays the same dollar amount of tax
Everyone pays the same share of income in tax
Lower earners pay a larger share of income in tax
a.why: A progressive tax takes a bigger share from higher incomes, which helps narrow the gap. Taking the same share from everyone is a flat tax, which does not do this.
a.clue: Think about who pays a bigger share as income rises.

b.q: Sam works part-time on the lowest legal hourly pay. Which measure directly raises the pay he can be offered?
opts: An increase in the minimum wage
A fall in the income tax rate for high earners
A rise in the cost of public schools
A cut in welfare payments to families
b.why: The minimum wage sets the lowest hourly pay, so raising it lifts Sam's pay directly. Cutting tax for high earners would not raise the pay of the lowest paid workers.
b.clue: Which measure sets a floor under hourly pay?

a.best: Higher earners pay a larger share of income in tax

b.best: An increase in the minimum wage
